name: appmixer.shopify.draftorders.CreateDraftOrder
description: Create a draft order, for example a quote or an order taken by phone, that the customer can pay through its invoice. Returns the draft order. Needs the write_draft_orders access scope on the Shopify app.
author: Appmixer <info@appmixer.com>

lineItems.label: Line Items
lineItems.tooltip: The products of the draft order. Each item is either a product variant of your store, or a custom item with its own title and price.

variantId.label: Product Variant
variantId.tooltip: Pick a product variant, or enter its ID (global or numeric). Its title and price are taken from the product.

title.label: Title
title.tooltip: The title of the custom item.

price.label: Unit Price
price.tooltip: The price of one custom item, in the store currency.

customerId.label: Customer
customerId.tooltip: Pick the customer, or enter the customer ID (global or numeric).

email.label: Email
email.tooltip: The customer's email address for the draft order.

phone.label: Phone
phone.tooltip: The customer's phone number, in E.164 format (for example +15145556789).

note.label: Note
note.tooltip: A note for the draft order.

taxExempt.label: Tax Exempt
taxExempt.tooltip: Whether the draft order is exempt from taxes.

shippingProvinceCode.label: Province Code
shippingProvinceCode.tooltip: State or province code, for example ON or CA. Names are not accepted.

shippingCountryCode.label: Country Code
shippingCountryCode.tooltip: Two-letter ISO country code, for example CZ or US. Names are not accepted.
